acceptanceCriteria: A make target (for example capabilities-check) runs the CAP-V0-002 catalog drift test, and it is in the documented local doc-gate list used by lanes and batches.
Adding an MCP tool or CLI command without a catalog row fails the local doc gates before push.
body: Batch beamfall/corvint#1549 failed go-product-shard (3) in CI on TestCAPV0002RepositoryCatalogMatchesInventory ('missing mcp-tools "corvint.map_knowledge": no catalog row') after lane #1548 added the tool. The lane and batch local doc gates passed because the catalog drift test has no make target and is not in the doc-gate list; it only runs inside the full go test sweep. Fixed for this batch in 9745e8c22 (catalog row added).
title: Capability catalog drift test has no make target, so local doc gates miss a new MCP tool without a catalog row
